verdict.reasoning: Rendered page 859 (printed 837, Index) shows three separate index entries at the top of the right-hand column: 'Abbreviated combined relation conditions 136', 'Abnormal run unit termination 391, 392, 393', 'ABS function 575', each on its own line. page-859.md line 59 holds all three as one paragraph with no hard-break backslashes, while every surrounding entry ends in '\' or is its own line. Rendered, they run together as one entry, so the entry boundaries and their page numbers are lost. The text itself is all present; the defect is the lost entry separation (a merge across the column break), not missing or misplaced text. The Index is informative, so the harm is to lookup, not to normative semantics.
